title: 第13章 周家反应第14章 四族老祖
slug: 全族助我加点我举族飞升天界
content_zh:
就在这时，李天心终于赶到，夜色之中，她仍旧可以看清场中状况。
“爹～你没事吧！”她急切地朝向天空之上那位银发老者叫喊一声。
“天心，下面几位就交给你除了了，等我处理完最后一个，便回来！”李北玄回头看向李天心说了一句。
没等李天心回应，他的身影便已经朝着湖心岛之外追去。
李天心看着追杀出去的父亲，又俯身看了一眼下方生死不明的黑衣修士。
她着实被眼前这一幕幕给震惊到了！
原本以为自己的老爹垂暮之年，气色一天不如一天，但没想到面对潜入的这些先天强者，却是摧枯拉朽一般，轻易就被他给解决了！
就在这时，李天行的声音也从远处传来。
“小妹，发生了何事？”
湖心岛弄出这般动静，早已经惊动到了李家。
所以他便第一时间朝湖心岛赶来，但是没想到，自己赶到的时候，也已经结束了。
“二哥，是四大家族的先天强者潜入我湖心岛，他们应该是为了试探爹的虚实而来！”李天心看向李天行道。
“还剩最后一个，爹去追击去了！”
李天行闻言，突然一愣，显然他也是没有想到老爹会如此厉害。
他看了一眼躺地不起那三位黑衣修士，而后再看了一眼自家老爹离去的方向。
他忍不住在心中感慨一番！
没过多久，李北玄便从远处极速而回。
见到李北玄回来，李天行脸上带着担忧之色，他看向李北玄出声问道，“爹，你怎么样了！没事吧！”
李天心也是满脸担忧地看向李北玄。
李北玄朝两人摆了摆手，脸上露出遗憾之色，“无事，只可惜还是没能留下最后那人！”

“不过那人施展出了燃血秘术，想必就算不死，他的境界也会大跌，对我们李家便又少了一个威胁！”
若不是因为自己大意，以为稳杀的局。
一不然对方怎么可能有机会施展出燃血之术。
“可是，爹，你今晚连斩他们三位先天强者，他们会不会与我们李家彻底撕破脸皮，联手对我李家开战？”李天行心中对此有些担忧。
就拿今晚来说，四大家族派遣先天潜入他们李家，他们也不得而知。
也是最后激战弄起巨大动静，他才第一时间赶来。
倘若四大家族彻底联手对他们李家动手的话，后果不敢想象！
一旁的李天心同样担忧地看向李北玄。
李北玄看出了他们的担忧，便出言说道，“你们放心吧，有了你爹我今晚的威慑，除非他们有把握对付我，不然短时间内是不会对我们李家动手的！”
“因为他们不敢跟我们李家赌命！”
李天行与李天心听完之后，脸上的担忧之色才缓和下来。
也正如父亲说的那样，只要他们李家有他坐镇，北源河畔四大家族便不敢对他们李家怎样！
李北玄指了指下方躺着的三位黑衣修士，“好了，他们便交给你们处理了。”
最后又看向李天行嘱咐一句，“最近还是要提高警惕，提防他们出阴招！”
毕竟现在已经触及了他们的利益，他们或许不敢明着来，但不代表他们不敢玩阴的！
“是，天行知道该怎么做了！”李天行神色认真地回道。
李北玄对他点了点头，而后便转身朝着阁楼而去！
李天行看到父亲已经离去，便看向身旁的李天心说道，“小妹，这三人我带回去处理了，湖心岛上你多加注意！”
content_en:
At this moment, Li Tianxin finally arrived. In the darkness, she could still see the situation clearly.
"Dad, are you okay?" She shouted eagerly towards the silver-haired old man in the sky.
"Tianxin, I'll leave the following ones to you. I'll come back after I finish taking care of the last one!" Li Beixuan looked back at Li Tianxin and said.
Before Li Tianxin could respond, his figure was already chasing away from the island in the middle of the lake.
Li Tianxin looked at his father who was chasing him, then leaned down and glanced at the unknown monk in black below.
She was really shocked by the scene before her!
I originally thought that my father was in his twilight years and his complexion was getting worse day by day, but I didn't expect that when faced with these innate strong men who had sneaked in, they were so devastated that they were easily defeated by him!
At this moment, Li Tianxing's voice came from a distance.
"Little sister, what happened?"
Such a movement on the island in the middle of the lake has already alarmed the Li family.
So he rushed towards the island in the middle of the lake as soon as possible, but he didn't expect that by the time he arrived, it was already over.
"Second brother, the innate experts from the four major families sneaked into my island in the middle of the lake. They should have come to test my father's truth!" Li Tianxin looked at Li Tianxing and said.
"There is one last one left, dad is going to chase him!"
When Li Tianxing heard this, he was suddenly stunned. Apparently, he did not expect that his father would be so powerful.
He glanced at the three monks in black who were lying on the ground, and then looked at the direction where his father was leaving.
He couldn't help but sigh in his heart!
It didn't take long for Li Beixuan to return quickly from a distance.
Seeing Li Beixuan come back, Li Tianxing had a worried look on his face. He looked at Li Beixuan and asked, "Dad, how are you? Are you okay?"
Li Tianxin also looked at Li Beixuan with worry on his face.
Li Beixuan waved his hands towards the two of them, with a look of regret on his face, "Nothing, but it's a pity that I still couldn't keep the last person!"
"But that man has used the blood-burning secret technique. Even if he doesn't die, his level will plummet, and there will be one less threat to our Li family!"
If it weren't for my own carelessness, I would have thought it was a sure kill.
Otherwise, how could the other party have the opportunity to perform the blood-burning technique?
"But, Dad, if you kill three of their innate experts tonight, will they completely break up with our Li family and join forces to start a war against my Li family?" Li Tianxing was a little worried about this.
Take tonight for example, the four major families sent Xiantian to sneak into their Li family, but they didn't know.
It was only when the fierce battle finally caused a huge noise that he rushed over immediately.
If the four major families completely join forces to attack the Li family, the consequences are unimaginable!
Li Tianxin on the side looked at Li Beixuan with the same concern.
Li Beixuan saw their worries and said, "Don't worry, with your father and me as a deterrent tonight, unless they are sure of dealing with me, they won't attack our Li family in a short time!"
"Because they don't dare to gamble their lives with our Li family!"
After Li Tianxing and Li Tianxin listened, the worried expressions on their faces softened.
Just as his father said, as long as he is in charge of the Li family, the four major families on the Beiyuan River will not dare to do anything to the Li family!
Li Beixuan pointed to the three monks in black lying below, "Okay, I'll leave them to you."
Finally, he looked at Li Tianxing and told him, "We should be more vigilant recently and beware of their dirty tricks!"
After all, their interests have been touched now. They may not dare to do it openly, but it does not mean that they dare not play dirty tricks!
"Yes, Tianxing knows what to do!" Li Tianxing replied seriously.
Li Beixuan nodded to him, then turned and headed towards the attic!
When Li Tianxing saw that his father had left, he looked at Li Tianxin beside him and said, "Little sister, I will take these three people back to deal with them. You should pay more attention to them on the island in the middle of the lake!"
